data.name: Underhanded Maneuvers
data.description: When she could normally make a sneak attack, a slayer may instead make a dirty trick or steal combat maneuver with a bonus on her roll. This bonus is equal to %1 for a dirty trick combat maneuver, or %2 for a steal combat maneuver.|SneakAttack|SneakAttack+SneakAttack/2
